function.description: Get the count of network devices that have network bugs detected by the network bug scan. Use this count tool for questions like 'how many devices have bugs?', 'count devices with network bugs', 'how many devices have failed bug scans?', or 'count devices scanned by CX Cloud'. For unqualified device bug count questions, call this tool with bugCount: 0 so only devices with at least one detected bug are counted. Do not call api_getNetworkBugDevices just to count devices.
function.name: api_getCountOfNetworkBugDevices

bugCount.description: Return the count of network devices with bugCount greater than this value. Use bugCount: 0 for devices-with-bugs count requests so only devices with at least one detected bug are counted.

scanMode.description: Mode or the criteria using which the network device was scanned. Available values : ESSENTIALS, ADVANTAGE, CX_CLOUD, NOT_AVAILABLE

scanStatus.description: Status of the scan on the network device. Available values : NOT_SCANNED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED, FALL_BACK

count.description: Count of network devices matching the scan filters; with bugCount: 0 this is the count of devices with at least one detected network bug.
